criteria.measurement: Source-backed dependency inventory and observed local/offline execution for a selected candidate

criteria.statement: Use the selected PDF's 16 multiple-choice and 4 constructed-response problems as a pilot, proceeding one problem at a time.
Progressively reduce manual comparison and human review gates using verified model performance.
criteria.measurement: Correction effort, review coverage, undetected errors and unresolved source uncertainty per model route; exact thresholds remain undefined

criteria.statement: The document is legible and arranged correctly at the agreed display or print scale.

proposals.statement: Use available source evidence, conservative image diagnostics or independent native references to establish uncertain content before authoring.
Record each uncertain token or stroke with source location, candidate readings, evidence and an explicit resolution; mathematical plausibility alone does not establish printed-source identity.
Select representative clear, blurred, overlapping-mark and multipart problems for a bounded reconstruction and review before full assembly.
Expose bounded domain operations through typed file inputs and outputs so existing native agent CLIs can use the program without embedding another agent runtime or a model-provider client.

Keep source-backed mathematical relationships, presentation settings, engine-specific source and rendered assets distinct. Recognized image coordinates alone do not establish mathematical relationships.

Compare native generative vision and vision Decision capabilities on shared candidate-selection/error-detection tasks, then evaluate end-to-end routes separately. Keep prompts, exact source regions, schemas, reference provenance and actual model IDs bound to each result.

Calibrate gate reductions on user-adjudicated cases and verify them on separate cases; preserve indeterminate source readings and measure automatic-accept errors rather than relying on model confidence or agreement alone.
